The '''Gree Temporary Mind-Link Device''' existed during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Time/Legends|temporary]] mind-link device of the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]],<ref name="TOR" /> an ancient technologically adept [[Species/Legends|species]] reputed for their [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Gree}}</ref> the apparatus featured twin [[Color/Legends|beige]] octahedra, with one vertex of each sharing a gray base.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gree Temporary Mind-Link Device appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as potential loot and a courting gift for companions.<ref name="TOR" />
